resources.string: Proteus (experimental)
Your own Proteus server, speaking a protocol you define in a PSF file. Needs a server you run. TCP only.
Tor over Proteus (experimental)
Tor dials out through your Proteus server, so the network only sees your custom protocol.
Proteus could not start: check the server address and the PSF on the Chain page (they must match the server).
Proteus did not reach the server in time. Check that the server is running and reachable, and that mode and persist match it.
Experimental. Proteus is a research tool: it needs your own server running the same PSF, and it carries TCP only (DNS goes over TCP through it; UDP apps and QUIC will not work).
Proteus server
1.2.3.4:8443 or example.com:8443
Use host:port, or [IPv6]:port.
Protocol specification (PSF)
Paste the content of the .psf file
Must be exactly the PSF the server runs with, including any password it defines.
Client mode
Tunnel
Stream
One long-lived connection to the server, every app stream inside it (VPN-like).
A separate connection to the server for every app stream (Shadowsocks-like).
Session persistence
Off
On
Recovers broken tunnels. Must match the server (proteus server --persist).
